name: Diseases of the Eyelids

clinicalPearls: Lash cornea touch means ulcer risk
reference.pathophysiology: Meibomian inspissation stagnates lipid, inviting bacterial lipases that saponify tears into irritants, while involutional canthal laxity and retractor dehiscence rotate lax lids and chronic tarsal scarring contracts posterior lamella inward.
additionalDifferentials: Stye versus chalazion by pain and course
Entropion versus ectropion by margin direction
Basal cell versus sebaceous carcinoma by age and behaviour
